definitions.explanation: The act of transporting goods or cargo from one place to another, typically by vehicle or ship.

examples.japanese: {運送|うんそう}⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{運送|うんそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{運送|うんそう}{費|ひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。

notes:
{運送|うんそう} refers to the commercial transportation of goods and cargo from one place to another, typically by truck, ship, or other vehicle. It focuses on the physical movement of items, not people.

FORMS:
⟦{運|うん}→運：02143_un⟧ (carry) + {送|そう} (send)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {運送|うんそう}⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧: shipping/transport company
- {運送|うんそう}{業|ぎょう}: transport industry
- {運送|うんそう}{費|ひ}: shipping cost
- {運送|うんそう}{業者|ぎょうしゃ}: freight carrier
- {運送|うんそう}⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧: transportation contract

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {運送|うんそう}: commercial transport of goods (business focus)
- ⟦{輸送|ゆそう}→輸送：04084_yusou⟧: transportation (broader, more formal, includes military)
- ⟦{配送|はいそう}→配送：05464_haisou⟧: delivery (final delivery to a destination)
- ⟦{宅配|たくはい}→宅配：09571_takuhai⟧: home delivery (specifically to residences)
- ⟦{運搬|うんぱん}→運搬：09231_unpan⟧: carrying, conveyance (physical act of moving items)

REGISTER:
Business/commercial term. In everyday speech, people are more likely to say ⟦{届|とど}ける→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧ (to deliver) or ⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧ (to send).
